title: MiniMax Agent H3 plugins for dynamic images and white-model rendering
summary: MiniMax Agent shipped H3-based plugins for dynamic images and white-model (clay) rendering. Author notes white-model quality is still being tuned but usable for experimenting with reference-driven video generation workflows.
